sentences.text: The ROBOBAK company which myself, Ben Puzzuoli, and Rob Puzzuoli co-founded, was acquired by KineticD.
VisionWorks Solutions Inc. which primarily worked on ROBOBAK was founded in 2003.
Likewise ACPANA dba KineticD was also founded in 2003.
You can read about it here, here, here, here, and here.
I am now working for the new company and still hold shares in the new company.
